newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker trade thin amid tight supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker trade thin amid tight supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunker trade ground to a near-halt as supplies ran out and shiponwers held back enquiries, traders said on Friday.

After taking out yesterday's high demand at lower prices, at least three majors were out of the market for January supplies while those with supplies witheld quotes, saying they were uncomfortable with current prices.
"Prices are not very low relative to the physical but relative to earlier bunker prices, they are," a major said.
One major sold 380-cst at $104 per tonne but independents were lower at $100-$102. Enquiries were very thin. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3086)
